content:
# Wide Range Slider Testing Notes

Checked on 2026-06-25 after the wide-range pass:

- Active NPC lab JavaScript parses with `node --check`:
  - `shared/js/backends.js`
  - `apps/npc-voice-lab/js/npc-lab-data.js`
  - `apps/npc-voice-lab/js/studio.js`
- Active vocal/acapella bridge JavaScript parses with `node --check`:
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/js/config.js`
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/js/voice-profile.js`
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/js/audio-analysis.js`
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/js/audio-export.js`
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/js/studio-app.js`
- Active JSON schemas/manifests parse:
  - `apps/npc-voice-lab/data/npc-lab-data.json`
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/data/voice_slider_schema.json`
  - `docs/manifests/PROJECT_MANIFEST.json`
- Python bridge files compile:
  - `backend/vocal-acapella/voice_acapella_pipeline.py`
  - `apps/vocal-acapella-studio/backend/voice_acapella_pipeline.py`

Manual browser audio quality still depends on the browser speech voice and whether the locked MP3 backend returns MP3. Local WAV export is the guaranteed audio path and now carries the stronger slider math.
